notes.title: Update: Fixed bugs in Last Labyrinth.
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that an update was released today and fixed the following issues.

 Applicable stores: Steam
 Supported devices: SteamVR compatible PC
 Update date: Thursday, October 31, 2024
 Major fixes/updates
[olist]
 Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented controller operation during a new installation.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update: Fixed some bugs in Last Labyrinth.
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that an update was released today and fixed the following issues.

 Applicable stores: Steam
 Supported devices: SteamVR compatible PC
 Update date: Tuesday, July 24, 2023
 Major fixes/updates
[olist]
 Fixed an issue that the controller instruction image is incorrect.
 Fixed an issue that Katia may fall into the pit in the Room of "Strength" under certain conditions.
 Fixed an issue that the hatch will fall before Katia walk across it in the Room of "Strength" under certain conditions.
 Fixed an issue that Katia will not press the button when holding a weight in the Room of "Justice" under certain conditions.
 Fixed an issue that the cut-scenes of game over and game clear are played simultaneously in the Room of "The Lovers" under certain conditions.
 Fixed an issue that Katia will move towards the door during chess games under certain conditions.
 Other minor improvements.
[/olist]

notes.title: Today, The Major Update to Add the Monitor Mode
notes.notes:
The Major Update to Add the Monitor Mode Last Labyrinth -Lucidity Lost- Applied to the SteamVR Versions on March 22, 2023

Today, the major update adding the Monitor Mode Last Labyrinth -Lucidity Lost- has been applied to the SteamVR version of the game. This update allows players without a VR headset to experience the world of Last Labyrinth on a PC.


Major Update Last Labyrinth -Lucidity Lost- Overview

 Update Title: Last Labyrinth -Lucidity Lost-
 Target Distribution Stores: Steam
 Target Hardware: Equivalent to SteamVR compatible PC (Minimum Requirements: Windows 10(64bit)/ Intel Core™i5 4590/ NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or above）
 Date of update: March 22nd, 2023
 Main Updates
[olist]
 Addition of the monitor mode L4.
 Addition of a share feature for saving data and trophies between the VR mode Last Labyrinth and the monitor mode L4.
 Other partial fixes to the game flow (including fixes to the VR mode Last Labyrinth)
[/olist]

notes.title: The Major Update to Add the Monitor Mode on Mar. 22, 2023
notes.notes:
The Major Update to Add the Monitor Mode Last Labyrinth -Lucidity Lost- Will Be Applied to the SteamVR Versions on March 22, 2023

We will also apply the major update that adds the monitor mode Last Labyrinth -Lucidity Lost-(hereinafter L4) for free to the SteamVR versions that are already in operation. This makes it possible to experience the world of Last Labyrinth on the PC by itself even if you do not own a VR headset.


Major Update Last Labyrinth -Lucidity Lost- Overview

 Update Title: Last Labyrinth -Lucidity Lost-
 Target Distribution Stores: Steam
 Target Hardware: Equivalent to SteamVR compatible PC (Minimum Requirements: Windows 10(64bit)/ Intel Core™i5 4590/ NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or above）
 Scheduled date of update: March 22nd, 2023
 Main Updates
[olist]
 Addition of the monitor mode L4.
 Addition of a share feature for saving data and trophies between the VR mode Last Labyrinth and the monitor mode L4.
 Other partial fixes to the game flow (including fixes to the VR mode Last Labyrinth)
[/olist]
